_meta.status: APPROVED — Claude PM 확정 (2026-08-11). WP7 ThemeManager 사용 가능.
_meta.notes: 테마 = 레이어 조합(6.2). 배경을 통째로 만들지 않고 하늘/먼산/중경/전경/날씨/조명 레이어를 조합·필터로 변주. 에셋 키는 assets manifest(구현)와 1:1(확장자만 다름). 설원/성벽은 2순위(23.11)이므로 tier-1(평원·숲·야경)만 활성.
_meta.revision: 2026-08-11: field midground = castle+tree (was far_mountain); night keeps house/moon. Fixes night-only house repeating in the field theme. | 2026-08-12: second tree species (mid_pine_green) in field/forest; mid_pine stays the snow-theme conifer per GDD 23.10 | 2026-08-12: mid_castle removed from the field theme — a castle recurring across open meadow made no sense in-fiction (user feedback). Field midground is trees only; density and depth variety now come from BackgroundLayer rather than from adding landmark props. | 2026-08-12: mid_tree_oak/mid_tree_small/mid_bush added to field/forest/night midgrounds (five species in the meadow). mid_moon moved out of the night midground — it is a sky object and SkyDecor owns it now, alongside sky_sun and sky_stars. | 2026-08-13: midgroundWeights added — the meadow reads as broadleaf with the odd conifer (field: oak 5 / big 4 / small 3 / bush 3 / pine 1), not an even mix. The forest keeps more conifer. sky_sun dropped. | 2026-08-13: fruit trees (mid_tree_apple/mid_tree_orange) join the meadow mix. | 2026-08-13: willow/poplar/maple/cherry added — the broadleaf species all had round canopies and read as one repeated tree, so these were chosen for silhouette contrast (drooping, narrow vertical, tiered, blossom). | 2026-08-13: mid_tree_willow dropped — the drooping form did not fit the game's tone (user call). Asset kept on disk in case a later theme wants it. | 2026-08-18: wall theme added and made the opening stage; rotation switched from time-based to every 1500m (sequence wall -> field). Each theme now names its own BGM pair, so the music changes with the stage. | 2026-08-18: BGM roles corrected — Adventure tracks are the normal-run beds, Rush tracks are the fever beds (user spec). Each stage takes one of each so the map still changes the music. | 2026-08-18: displayTitle localised to Korean — it is shown to the player on stage entry, so FIELD/FOREST read as debug labels. | 2026-08-18: obstacleSkins added — the wall stage restyles rock/stump/tree as rubble, barrel and turret. Art only: size, collider and required action stay with the type, so difficulty is unchanged. spike keeps its meadow sprite, which already suits a rampart. | 2026-08-18: stage rotation 1500m -> 1000m (user call — 1500m read as too long a stretch per stage). | 2026-08-19: obstacleVariants added — the wall stage's tall hazard now alternates between the turret and a knight statue (user request). The statue is deliberately slimmer, so its variant narrows the collider to 26px; without that the 36px tree body would hit the player through empty air beside a 25px-wide sprite. | 2026-08-19: knight variant weighted 3:1 over the turret. Measured over a full wall stage, the tall hazard spawns only ~3 times (tree unlocks at 400m and the calm window starts at 840m), so an even split left the statue almost never on screen (user report). | 2026-08-21: palace guard joins the wall stage's tall hazard pool (user request). Weighted level with the knight statue: the stage is the palace escape, so a sentry blocking the way belongs there as much as the statuary. Collider 28px to match its silhouette. | 2026-08-21: palace candelabra joins the wall stage's tall pool — 40x128, an exact match for the tree slot. Stage 1 is the palace interior (GDD v6.0 §4) and rubble reads as ramparts rather than staterooms. The armour stand is held back: it is 34x96, which fits no existing type. On the stump slot (34x30) it would be squashed, and on the tree slot (40x128) the collider would stand 15px taller than the art. It needs either a 40x128 redraw or an obstacle type of its own with segment data to match. | 2026-08-21: guard redrawn at 56x73 as a chibi sentry facing the runner (user call) and moved off the tall pool — at that size it is no longer a column. Held out of rotation until it has a slot whose footprint matches, same reason as the armour stand. | 2026-08-21: guard placed on the largeRock slot as an ordinary jump-over obstacle (user call — it is not a tall hazard). obstacleVariants gained display and collider size overrides so art that is not drawn to a type's footprint can still render at its true size without the collider drifting away from it. | 2026-08-21: candelabra dropped from the tall pool (user call) and the remaining tall looks evened to 3/3/3 so none dominates. The armour stand joins the stump slot at its true 34x96 with a matching collider — the display overrides added for the guard make that possible without squashing it or leaving the collider adrift. | 2026-08-21: the armoured figure reads as a suit of armour rather than a soldier, so it becomes wall_breastplate — a standing suit on the largeRock slot — and the guard is being redrawn as an actual sentry (user call). | 2026-08-21: the sentry returns as a knight in plate with a planted sword, five frames — standing, spotting her, flinching back — sharing the largeRock slot with the standing suit of armour. Both are normal jump-over hazards; new obstacles default to that unless stated otherwise (user rule). | 2026-08-21: wall_breastplate pulled from rotation. It is the previous front-facing sentry, not a suit of armour — splitting it out under that name was a misread on my part, and in play it simply looked like the old guard had come back (user report). The knight is the only sentry now.
